answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 58883 Country: India Title: Offer namaz in sitting position while in class. Question: I am a student and I go to coaching classes in the evening while Asar and Maghrib timings. There is not sufficient space to offer salah in standing position. We are also not allowed to leave the class. So can I offer salah while sitting on bench by gesture? Answer ID: 58883 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 403/368/SN=06/1436) It is not lawful for you to offer salah while sitting by gesture in the light of the question mentioned above. Your salah shall not be valid. You should demand the authority to allot you time for offering salah otherwise join any other coaching centre where you may get the facility of offering salah. Or choose such a time for your coaching that the times of any salah does not fall in between. In short, it shall not be lawful for you to miss fardh salah for coaching according to Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
